name: Living is Expensive...
source:
“Defeat my sleep deprivation monsters. And I will cure your poverty virus.”

Living is Expensive... is a visual novel about the cost of existence & minimum wage vampires.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“打败我的睡眠剥夺怪兽，我就治好你的贫穷病毒。”

《活着好贵》是一部探讨生存成本与领着最低时薪打工的吸血鬼的视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159050/]Steam[/url]]
